description: Report the progress of a crawl started by start_crawl: state ("queued", "running", "finished" or "failed"), the crawl session_id to read results from, the pages stored so far, and the error text if it failed. Poll every few seconds; a queued crawl starts as soon as the worker is free. Do not call issues_summary or query_issues for that crawl until state is "finished", or you will read a partial result.

job_id.description: The job id returned by start_crawl.

name: crawl_status
